title: A test rename that drops a done item's selector is refused by the worker's own checks, not first at the landing
goal: A worker whose change renames a test runs backlog.py selectors (or its brief names the selectors of done items that collect that test), so a rename that drops one is caught on the branch; answers SP-uwkr7iyl, where ST-6ljkrwt2 renamed the shared census test, dropped census_queue, and land stopped at sync's selectors gate.
notes: Retrospective finding of SP-uwkr7iyl close, 2026-10-10. Its check passes before the work: planning replaces it with one that fails until the change lands. SP-hlt2tdel close, 2026-10-14: again. ST-lp5pxtpe's worker renamed the brief test to carry brief_find_before_filing and dropped the substring brief_known_suite_failure that done ST-cr6lmafy selects; land stopped at kbgit.py sync --push (gate backlog.py selectors refused=1); the orchestrator renamed it to carry both and relanded.
